summary: Comprehensive backend testing for ZapFlow API. All 40 pytest cases passed (100%) covering auth, dashboard, contacts (incl. CSV PT/EN), templates, WhatsApp sessions (mock QR + auto-connect), campaigns (lifecycle simulation + credits deduction), reports, credits (recharge bounds), and AI endpoints (Claude Sonnet 4.5 + OpenAI TTS). WebSocket /api/ws verified manually (good-token connects, bad-token rejected with 1008).

minor.issue: `bg: BackgroundTasks = None` default can NoneType.add_task crash if FastAPI injection ever fails; safer to drop default None
Pydantic EmailStr rejects test TLDs like .test/.local; not a bug but worth noting for future test data
`balance_after` in consumo transaction is computed from pre-decrement user['credits'] snapshot instead of post-decrement (off by one) – display only inconsistency
No auth on amount type (negative values blocked by <10 check, but 0 or NaN passes amount float – validated acceptable)

action_items: (Optional) Tighten campaign_runner balance_after calculation to use post-decrement value
(Optional) Remove default None on BackgroundTasks param in connect_session for safety
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (583 lines) is still under 700 line split threshold but growing — consider splitting into routers (auth/contacts/campaigns/ai) as features grow
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection {_id: 0} throughout - good
All endpoints use async motor and Depends(get_current_user) for auth - good
Pydantic validation present on every POST body - good
Credits deduction is properly isolated per user inside campaign_runner
Mock flows clearly labeled (QR pattern generation, auto-connect 8s timer, recharge direct balance update, message lifecycle simulation)
WebSocket auth via query param token is acceptable for SaaS preview
test_credentials: Pre-existing demo user demo@zapflow.com / demo12345 was NOT used because backend testing creates fresh TEST_ users per-run. Fresh users auto-get R$25 welcome bonus.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a unique TEST user (test_<hex>@zapflow-qa.com) plus several contacts/templates/session/campaign that are cleaned up at end of run.
